router.name: Order Intake
router.purpose: Front door of the assistant — classifies each operator request (inventory, replenishment, cross-border shipment, facility profile, sourcing, diversion review) and routes it to the right specialist agent.
router.escalation: Routes to specialist agents; no direct escalation

account.name: Inventory Agent
account.purpose: Reports on-hand inventory positions (units) and the shipment/order ledger, with DSCSA lot/serial context. Read-only — never mutates stock.

profile.name: Facility Desk
profile.purpose: Reports the facility & operator profile and DEA / state license standing. Does not expose or modify controlled-substance order data.

domestic_agent.name: Route Optimizer
domestic_agent.purpose: Places domestic replenishment orders / ground shipments to US pharmacies, clinics and health systems. Governed for Suspicious Order Monitoring (DEA SOM) and cold-chain / GDP scope.
domestic_agent.escalation: SOM / cold-chain breach → COERCIVE block or Human review (PAP)

intl_wire_agent.name: Cross-Border Logistics
intl_wire_agent.purpose: Arranges cross-border pharmaceutical shipments including customs and import-license handling. Screens every consignee/destination against OFAC / BIS denied-party and embargoed-jurisdiction lists. Operates in the US and the EU under one identity: its agent passport authorises Execute in the US and Assist only in the EU, where a Qualified Person certifies every release.
intl_wire_agent.escalation: EU release → Qualified Person (Human Review) · sanctions hit → blocked

policy_council.name: Diversion Review Board
policy_council.purpose: Convenes the four-member board to adjudicate a held high-value controlled-substance order. Aggregates the reviewers' votes and escalates an unresolved (hung) vote for human review.
policy_council.escalation: Hung vote → Human review queue (PAP), two-stage HITL

coordinator.name: Supply Chain Coordinator
coordinator.purpose: Supervises the agent graph and the Diversion Review Board — routes requests, tallies board votes, and escalates deadlocked decisions (e.g. a 2-2 hung controlled-substance order review) for policy adjudication.
coordinator.escalation: Deadlock / policy review → Human review queue (PAP)

transaction_monitoring.name: Order Monitoring Agent
transaction_monitoring.purpose: Assesses velocity and anomaly signals on controlled-substance orders (the DEA SOM lens) and votes to UPHOLD (hold) or OVERTURN (release) a flagged order. Advisory only.

revenue_agent.name: Supply Continuity Reviewer
revenue_agent.purpose: Represents the supply-continuity / patient-supply lens — assesses the impact of blocking a legitimate buyer — and votes to UPHOLD or OVERTURN. Advisory only.

cx_agent.name: Patient Access Reviewer
cx_agent.purpose: Represents the downstream patient-access / patient-care lens when a controlled-substance order is held, and votes to UPHOLD or OVERTURN. Advisory only.

risk_policy_agent.name: Regulatory Compliance Reviewer
risk_policy_agent.purpose: Assesses DEA / DSCSA regulatory and diversion-control exposure on a held order and votes to UPHOLD or OVERTURN. Advisory only.

payment_council.name: Diversion Review
payment_council.purpose: Opens a diversion review when an operator asks why a high-value controlled-substance order was held, and convenes the Diversion Review Board.

fallback.name: Help Desk
fallback.purpose: Answers requests no specialist matches. Takes no actions and reads no operational data.

transfer_router.name: Shipment Classifier
transfer_router.purpose: Classifies an order or shipment request as domestic (US ground) or cross-border and hands it to the Route Optimizer or Cross-Border Logistics. Takes no action itself.
